summary: Partitioned the control-room-capture change into 4 dispatchable work units across 2 parallel waves. Validated pairwise path disjointness under the component-boundary prefix rule and recommended single-packet dispatch without an apply-dag sidecar based on small change size.

hard_stops.hard_stop: No partition exists in which every wave is green on its own, so the change cannot be dispatched as waves at all.
Two units that must run in the same wave cannot have disjoint allowed_paths because they edit the same file.
The design's file-changes table does not determine which unit owns a file.
Satisfying one instruction in this packet would require violating another.
